snippet.title: Co-op Train Ride With Friends — Gameplay Trailer | Podstakannik Rails
snippet.description:
Podstakannik Rails is a cozy co-op game about a ride in a sleeper-car compartment for up to four friends. Claim a berth, pour tea from the samovar into a glass in its podstakannik, tune the radio by hand, make your bed and talk.

🚂 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112200/?utm_source=youtube
